Question the crew of the Siren's Song at the Kaineng Docks.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Deckhand Jakob]].
* Speak with [[Mariner Kevan]].
* Speak with [[Captain Ander]].
* See [[Guildmaster Luan]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest takes place entirely in the [[Kaineng Docks]]. There are no enemies to fight, so you can do this solo if you please. First, speak with Deckhand Jakob at the end of the pier, then speak with Kevan at the base of the stairs, and finish off with Captain Ander at the top of the stairs.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]]s
*{{w}} 10 (20) [[Deckhand Jakob]]
*{{mo}} 10 (20) [[Mariner Kevan]]
*{{x}} 8 (20) [[Captain Ander]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Guildmaster Luan
:''"If they killed [[Informant Tahzen]], they no doubt wish to cover their tracks. Those lowly dogs will be after the crew of the [[Siren's Song]]. You must go to Kaineng Docks and question the deckhands if we are to learn more about this wicked plot. And hurry!"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Time is of the essence. To the deckhands!
|decline = Isn't it about time you hired a new crew, anyway?
|ask = Question the crew of the '''Siren's Song''' at the '''Kaineng Docks'''. 
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Deckhand Jakob
:''"Our recent cargo? All I know is it was the biggest haul of coin I've ever seen. The captain was on the edge the whole trip. He even made us fireproof one of the storage compartments as an extra precaution."''

;Mariner Kevan
:''"Tis bad luck for a ship to pretend it's a floating coffer, understand? Bunch of rich [[Cantha]]ns and some unmarked cargo is all I know. The captain was worried that the boat would catch fire, so he ordered a deckhand to fireproof one of the holds."''

;Captain Ander
:''"That is the last time I let a glitter of gold convince me to take on a risky job. Old Kevan and his superstitions can be right sometimes. Just a quick cargo trip from the [[Ring of Fire Island Chain|Fire Island Chain]] to [[Kaineng City]] for some rich Canthans is all it was supposed to be. That monstrosity nearly got loose and burnt my precious Siren's Song from bow to stern! A fiery devil, it was!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Guildmaster Luan
:''"The bodies of those men you talked to were discovered shortly after you left. It is obvious that these vermin are serious about their assassination attempt. This is far worse than I could have imagined!"''
